blocks.text: Silver/silver ion electrode aur copper/copper(II) ion electrode se bane cell mein yeh reaction hota hai:
Jab E cell ko silver ion ki concentration ke muqable plot kiya jaye to Figure 10.11 jaisa graph milta hai.

blocks.alt: E cell / V (0 se 0.5) ka log [Ag+] (-8 se 0) ke muqable graph. Seedhi lakeer log [Ag+] = -7.8 ke qareeb 0 V se log [Ag+] = 0 par 0.46 V tak charhti hai, jahan teer use E standard cell batata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.11: Cell reaction mein silver ions ki concentration barhana (kitab ki Figure 10.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: x-axis par log [Ag⁺] aur y-axis par E cell hai. Seedhi line oopar ja rahi hai: Ag⁺ ki concentration jitni zyada, E cell utna zyada positive. Jab [Ag⁺] = 1 mol dm⁻³ (log = 0) ho to E cell = E°cell = 0.46 V.

Dhyan dein ke graph mein E cell (poore cell ki non-standard value) ko silver ion concentration ke logarithm ke muqable plot kiya gaya hai. Ag⁺ ki concentration barhane se upar wala reaction aage barhta hai aur E cell zyada positive hota hai.
Concentration aur temperature ka E cell par asar Nernst equation se nikala jata hai. Kisi electrode, maslan Cu(s)/Cu²⁺(aq), ke liye relation yeh hai:

blocks.text_alt: E = E° + (RT / zF) ln ([oxidized form] / [reduced form])

items: E = non-standard conditions mein electrode potential
R = gas constant, 8.314 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
z = reaction mein transfer hone wale electrons ki tadaad
[oxidized] = half-equation mein oxidized shakal ki concentration
[reduced] = half-equation mein reduced shakal ki concentration.

blocks.text: Metal/metal ion electrode ke liye yeh equation asaan ho jati hai:

items: Natural logarithm (ln) aur base 10 wale log ka relation:
Standard temperature (298 K) par R, T aur F constant hain, is liye 2.303RT/F = 0.059 V.

blocks.text: To equation yeh ban jati hai:

blocks.text_alt: E = E° + (0.059 / z) log ([oxidized form] / [reduced form])

blocks.title: Sample problem
blocks.problem: 0.1 M Zn²⁺ ions wale solution mein dube zinc electrode ka electrode potential kya hoga? Zn²⁺/Zn ka E° = −0.76 V hai.
steps: Half-equation: Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Zn, E° = −0.76 V, z = 2. Metal (Zn) ki concentration 1 maani jati hai.
blocks.answer: E = −0.79 V. Zn²⁺ ki concentration kam hone se equilibrium peechhe (backward) shift hota hai aur electrode potential −0.76 V se ghat kar −0.79 V ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein half-cell “Zn²⁺ / ZnO” likha hai; sahi Zn²⁺/Zn hai. Kitab ne jawab −0.78 V diya hai, lekin −0.76 + (−0.029) = −0.789, yani −0.79 V banta hai.

blocks.prompt: 0.01 M Cu²⁺ mein copper electrode ka potential nikalein (E° Cu²⁺/Cu = +0.34 V).

items: Nernst: E = E° + (RT/zF) ln([oxidized]/[reduced]); 298 K par E = E° + (0.059/z) log([oxidized]/[reduced]).
Cu + 2Ag⁺ (E° = +0.46 V): [Ag⁺] barhane se E cell barhta hai.
0.1 M Zn²⁺ mein Zn: E = −0.79 V (concentration kam → E zyada negative).
